mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Federal Funds rate above the prior month's level coincides with a negative 20-day S&P 500 forward return due to higher discount rates eroding expected equity payoffs.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS crosses above its previous month's value by more than 0.25 percentage points
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, 20-day forward returns do not diverge significantly from a no-rate-change baseline (t-test p > 0.1), or FEDFUNDS increases are not followed by negative SPX returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden spike in unemployment claims (PAYEMS) accompanied by a simultaneous decline in consumer demand indicators (HOUST) predicts a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as investor sentiment deteriorates.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > previous month by > 10,000 and HOUST < previous month
regime_hint: Labor market stress combined with weak demand
failure_condition: Over 6 months, the joint signal recurs but produces positive 60-day forward returns (p > 0.05 two-tailed test), or unemployment spikes are not followed by demand weakness.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below trend signals supply-side weakness that manifests as a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as investors price in economic recovery.
regime_hint: Early stage of supply shock recovery
failure_condition: INDPRO remains below trend for > 6 months without a significant positive SPX 20-day return (Rank IC < 0.05), or multiple supply indicators show no divergence.

mechanism_narrative: Consecutive months of rising consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) above 3% triggers a negative 5-day S&P 500 forward return as market anticipates rate hikes that compress equity valuations.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL crosses above 3% for two consecutive months
failure_condition: Over 12 months, CPIAUCSL remains below 3% or the 5-day forward returns are not statistically negative (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tightening labor market, which precedes a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as equities benefit from growth momentum.
failure_condition: UNRATE does not show a sustained decline for > 6 months without a positive SPX 20-day return (p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in monthly payrolls (PAYEMS) below 200,000 coincides with a decline in manufacturing activity (RSAFS), producing a negative 60-day S&P 500 forward return as recession risk rises.
failure_condition: The joint signal recurs but is not followed by negative 60-day returns (p > 0.05), or manufacturing recovers while payrolls remain weak.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in retail sales (not available in provided proxies; fallback: a sustained rise in industrial production (INDPRO) for 3 months predicts a positive 20-day S&P 500 forward return as demand recovers.
Note: No retail sales proxy available; using INDPRO as a demand proxy for supply-side recovery signal.
failure_condition: INDPRO does not show sustained upward trend for > 6 months without a positive SPX 20-day return.

mechanism_narrative: When the 3-month moving average of FEDFUNDS falls below 4%, it predicts a positive 60-day S&P 500 forward return as markets anticipate easing and price in future equity growth.
failure_condition: Over a 12-month window, the FEDFUNDS MA does not fall below 4% or the 60-day forward returns remain negative (p > 0.1).
